text:
Subject: Important Reminder Regarding Punctuality

Hi [Name],

I wanted to touch base regarding our recent client meetings. It is important to understand that being late to client meetings reflects poorly on our company's professionalism. Your tardiness has been noted several times, and this pattern cannot continue.

To help ensure we are all aligned on the importance of timeliness, consider the natural world for a moment: fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, and just as those clouds must gather and release their water at the right moment, we too must be present and ready for our commitments.

Future instances of lateness may result in disciplinary action, so please take the necessary steps to arrive on time.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
